name: 02129 · Charlestown, MA
findings: ZIP 02129 (Charlestown) has 124 nonprofit organizations. 49 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02129 (Charlestown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 02129 (Charlestown) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 43 organizations here; 15% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.text: 14 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
